scripts.check: node --check src/index.js && node --check src/worker.js && node --check src/standings-worker.js && node --check src/published-standings.js && node --check src/schema-bootstrap.js && node --check src/statewide-initializer.js && node --check src/schedule-response-normalizer.js && node --check src/record-rebuild.js && node --check src/school-branding.js && node --check src/school-branding-curated.js && node --check src/school-branding-curated-sync.js && node --check src/d1-usage-monitor.js && node --check src/d1-usage-public-worker.js && node --check ../live-data.js && node --check ../school-follow-logic.js && node --check ../team-detail.js && node --check ../school-schedule.js && node --check ../school-logo-ui.js && node --check ../standings.js && node --test test/*.test.js budget-tests/*.test.js
scripts.deploy:cloudflare: npm run check && wrangler d1 execute localbleachersar-sports --remote --command="SELECT COUNT(*) AS batch2_runs,SUM(CASE WHEN cr.status='SUCCESS' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS success_runs,SUM(CASE WHEN cr.status='FAILURE' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS failure_runs,SUM(CASE WHEN cr.status='NOT_MODIFIED' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS not_modified_runs,MIN(cr.started_at) AS first_started_at,MAX(cr.started_at) AS last_started_at FROM collection_runs cr JOIN sources src ON src.id=cr.source_id JOIN teams t ON t.id=src.team_id JOIN schools sch ON sch.id=t.school_id WHERE sch.level='college' AND sch.catalog_scope='local' AND t.season='2026' AND datetime(cr.started_at)>=datetime('2026-09-04T14:51:50Z') AND datetime(cr.started_at)<datetime('2026-09-04T14:53:00Z')" --json | grep -Eq '"batch2_runs"[[:space:]]*:[[:space:]]*[1-9][0-9]*'
